title: Love the rug but disappointed with condition
text: Love the rug but disappointed with condition. We have been waiting 2 weeks for our new flooring to be installed so we can unpack and decorate our new home, hence the time between purchase and this review. The rug is beautiful, the colors are bright and it matches our bedroom perfectly. I realize it is not the priciest rug on the market but we still expect quality. Upon rolling out our rug we see there are two lines that run nearly the entire length of the rug where the stitching is pulled, threads are broken and broken strands of fibers hang loose through the entire middle of the rug. I have so much to do with our move and do not need the hassle of returning and repurchasing another rug. Such a hassle and such an eye sore in my beautiful new bedroom. I will probably just move the rug so that the bad section is hidden under the bed but am completely disappointed with my purchase. I know that defects happen but I probably will not take a chance with this rug brand for the other rugs I buy for my new home.
